lines: Every time you reach for that, something burns that didn’t have to.

say: You can't, can you. That's why we don't start there.

lines: Too heavy. You're not ready for that one.
Not that one. It is beyond you, for now.
That wasn't you choosing. That was it choosing for you.
The charm is in your pocket. It isn't a punishment.
Breathe. It answers you. Even when you don't ask.

say: The road climbs for an hour, then drops into the Reach.
There’s an Oruun ruin across the pass. Older than Veyra. Older than the Empire.
Nobody’s opened its passage in a long time. You will.
So. The fire in Veyra. That was you.
Fire is the loudest thing in you. We are not starting there.
Earth. It doesn't rush. Neither will you.
That stone. Lift it.
Good. Now hold it. Don't fight it. Feel where it wants to fall.
Steadier.
Now set it down on the plate. Set it. Don’t drop it.

steps.objective: Set it down on the plate

say: That was a drop. Pick it up. Again.
There.
Stone remembers how it was treated. So do people.
More stones. Some you can lift. Some you can’t, yet.
The passage is sealed. You could break it. You probably want to.
There's a way through that leaves it standing. Find it.
I said we were not starting with fire.
Look at it. That's what untrained fire does. It doesn't open things. It ends them.
The Reach is on the other side. Walk with me.
It's open. So is everything else, now.
Power isn't the hard part. You'll find that out.
The Reach is on the other side. Walk with me.
It's still standing.
You opened a door without breaking it. Most Wielders never learn that.
The Reach is on the other side. Walk with me.
Over the wall. That’s one way through.
Not the one I’d have picked. But you’re through.

steps.objective: Follow Cael on into the Verdant Reach
